title: Re-Rated Primary Care Copay by Practice Type
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — schedule of re-rated primary care copays by practice type**

When visits the member's own primary care provider billed under the specialist visit copay are re-rated as primary care visits, the copay at which each re-rated visit is rated follows the practice type of the member's current assignment, as the Primary Care Provider Assignment records show it for the active assignment.

| Practice type of the current assignment | Re-rated copay per visit |
|---|---|
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 2.00 USD |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 2.00 USD |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 0.50 USD |
| Any other practice type (for example Standard Primary Care Provider, Pediatric Primary Care Provider, OB/GYN Primary Care Provider, Specialist Serving as PCP) | The category's primary care visit copay |

**Clause.** A Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home re-rates at the medical-home visit copay of 2.00 USD, a Health Home Lead Provider re-rates at the health-home visit copay of 0.50 USD, and any other practice keeps the category's primary care visit copay.

## Reading the schedule

- The practice type read is that of the assignment in active status on the review date, not of an ended assignment.
- The figure is a per-visit copay: each re-rated visit is rated at it, and the re-rated copays of the visits are added together.

## Hypothetical illustration

Inputs chosen for illustration only: three re-rated visits, each booked at 3.00.

| Current practice type | Re-rated copays for the three visits |
|---|---|
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | three times 2.00, that is 6.00 |
| Health Home Lead Provider | three times 0.50, that is 1.50 |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider, in a category whose primary care visit copay is a hypothetical 5.00 | three times 5.00, that is 15.00 |
